name: Lentil Zucchini Boats with Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto, Parmesan & Potatoes
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve potatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring once, until potatoes are golden and fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim and halve zucchini lengthwise. Scrape out the soft flesh from the middle of each half, place in a medium bowl, and set aside for later use.
Arrange zucchini halves, cut-side up, on another baking sheet; drizzle with additional oil and season with salt and pepper.
Add zucchini boats to the oven and bake until starting to soften, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly chop reserved zucchini flesh and return to the bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Drain and rinse lentils. Add to the bowl along with Parmesan, salt, and pepper. Set aside.

Place pesto, mayo, salt, and pepper in a small bowl; stir to combine the sauce. Add half of the sauce to the bowl with the lentils and stir to combine the filling. (Set remaining sauce aside for serving.)
Remove zucchini boats from the oven and divide filling between them.
Return zucchini boats to the oven and continue to bake until flesh is tender and filling is warmed through, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide zucchini boats, potatoes, and remaining sauce between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
